purpose: Probe A through the monitor (docs/plans/delegation-threads.md): the application mints a context, offers the seal through its invocation descriptor, the launcher has the monitor ADOPT it and steps it, from its main thread (REGISTER) or from a Linux thread of its own (THREAD); a revoked context steps DEAD, forgets once and is STALE afterwards; dead registrations are retired on shortage

qemu.source: capstone-qemu qemu/context-slots-on-pin a53ac18e3d (the context-slots commits on the pinned ac2837aa0e; tree identical to qemu/context-slots d220ab6ee9): DEAD status, privilege refusal, A7's test-only node instruments (off unless CAPSTONE_TEST_NODE_QUERY), and the sealed-return access window (P0/A2). Pre-P0 binary 9b6eac4b is 3589d6af6f

firmware.monitor: capstone-sbi monitor/context-slots 7e1c34f, in caplifive-opensbi wrapper/context-slots a4bdd1b (buildroot components/opensbi at a6c0174); build recipe reproduces the base firmware's disassembly exactly (0 of 49168 lines differ) from the unchanged monitor

module.source: modcapstone at caplifive-buildroot modcapstone/context-slots e3a43d4; the pinned a6c0174 builds the same code (0 of 3818 disassembly lines differ; 26 bytes of build path differ)

launcher.source: capstone-exec built from this branch against that libcapstone, with the P1 signal-mask fix (a new THREAD-mode context inherits a full signal block at creation). The P0 modes above were measured on launcher da83c9b9 and re-run on this one: context probe 33/33, signal contract 26/26, application gate exit 0 with 21 PASS lines

platform.vm: one hart, 8 GiB, CMA 1024 MiB, process cache 384 MiB, CAPSTONE_GP_NONLIN=1, CAPSTONE_REV_NODES=65536

modes.adopt-enter: PASS: ADOPT, the seal left the application's slot, STEP to RETURNED with EXITED in the result word; own stack and TLS, one counter, constructors once; FORGET 0
modes.adopt-thread: PASS: a launcher thread steps the context while the main context yields; done and the return value observed
modes.adopt-preempt: PASS: 1580 PREEMPTED steps, then RETURNED with EXITED and the parent's LCG value
modes.adopt-reenter: PASS: three further steps of the exited context each RETURNED with EXITED
modes.adopt-dead: PASS: after the domain revoked the area, two steps DEAD, FORGET 0, FORGET again ESTALE, STEP refused; the same area minted anew as id 0x600000001 after 0x500000001 (slot 1, next generation) returns 1007
modes.reenter-revoked: PASS (A4): the start block, TLS block and stack revoked through their own handles while the seal stays valid; three further steps each RETURNED with EXITED
modes.done-preempted: PASS (A6): stepped until done was published and the last event was PREEMPTED with its pc inside probe_exit_delay_begin..end; the joiner copied 4242, revoked, minted anew into the same area; the old id then steps DEAD and the new context returns 1009
modes.rollback-thread: PASS (A11), run with CAPSTONE_CONTEXT_TEST_THREAD_FAILS=1: CONTEXT_CREATE in thread mode answers EAGAIN and no child ran; after a new offer under ticket 1001, the old ticket 1000 gets ESTALE and 1001 is adopted
modes.duplicate-adopt: PASS (A13, first part): a second CONTEXT_CREATE with the consumed ticket gets ENOENT
modes.two-steppers: PASS (A13, second part): a launcher thread and the main thread step one context, 779 of the steps from the main thread; one continuous execution, the parent's LCG value
modes.loan-preempt: PASS (A14): a copy of the descriptor taken before 40,000,000 LCG rounds still writes after the resumes
modes.loan-after-return: PASS (A15, negative): a copy of the main context's descriptor kept past a delegated round faults at probe_store_insn with cause 24 (it reloads untagged); CONTROL on the base platform: the same image prints REACHED, the result slot there survives the call
modes.ctl-csr: PASS (A12): a machine CSR read faults with cause 2 at probe_csr_insn
modes.ctl-mret: PASS (A12): mret faults with cause 2 at probe_mret_insn. BEFORE the supervisor change (image f6efd377): carried out, the context entered user mode and faulted with cause 12 at its first fetch (pc 0xc0220010, the loop mret jumped to)
modes.ctl-priv: PASS (A12): a seal minted with user privilege is REFUSED (step event 5) and not entered. BEFORE (image f6efd377): entered in user mode, cause 12 at the entry (pc 0xc0200220)
modes.ctl-mie: PASS (A12): a seal enabling machine interrupts (mie 0x888) runs confined: 2072 preemptions in 8289 ms, the parent's value
modes.ctl-priv-nested: PASS (A12, negative): the main context's direct CALL of a user-privilege seal faults with cause 2 at __capstone_context_call_insn
modes.ctl-wfi: PASS (A12, run explicitly, second boot of the same files): wfi is a no-op on this platform; the context returns EXITED
modes.entry-audit: PASS as a register-tag audit; A2 as a whole is closed by the sealed-return access window (P0, capstone-qemu a53ac18e3d) with the ra-slot* modes as its controls. At the first entry instruction the LCC types of x1..x31 are 5 (x1, sealed return), 1 (x3, gp), 1 (x11, a1) and 7 (untagged) for every other register; gp equals the main context's entry gp; a1 is a 64-byte write-only descriptor outside gp; cscratch is exactly the start block
modes.entry-audit-control: PASS (A2, positive control): an entry that copies gp into s1 before the audit is reported as extra tagged register x9
modes.entry-negative: PASS (A2, negative): a store one word past the loan faults with cause 7 at probe_store_insn (capstone-qemu reports an out-of-bounds data access as an access fault). Observed, not checked: a load through the write-only loan returns normally (kind 0), since capstone-qemu has no permission clause on data access
modes.ra-slot0: PASS (A2 negative, P0): reading seal offset 0 (the caller's saved pc) through the sealed-return capability ra faults with cause 5 at the ldc; before the fix (binary 9b6eac4b) it returned and the context ran to completion
modes.ra-slot16: PASS (A2 negative, P0): offset 16 (ctvec) through ra faults with cause 5 at the ldc; before the fix it did not
modes.ra-slot32: PASS (A2 negative, P0): offset 32 (cscratch, a monitor capability in a supervised context) through ra faults with cause 5 at the ldc; before the fix it returned an RWX capability on monitor memory and a scalar load through it succeeded (the refutation of A2, review 2026-09-30)
modes.ra-gp: PASS (A2 control, P0): reading offset 48 (the first general-purpose slot, inside the sealed-return window) through ra does not fault; the context runs to 42
modes.exhaust: PASS (A10): 128 create/exit/revoke cycles in one application without FORGET, the live context stepped once per cycle and then to completion with its value; the dead registrations used 6 slots (mask 0xfc), highest generation 23. CONTROL on the firmware and module before A10 (825f2cd1, d47f7b44, image 92a5cb35, the same source for this mode): cycle 6 gets ENOSPC
modes.exhaust-ended: PASS (A10): 64 contexts in fresh 16 KiB areas, half faulting at probe_csr_insn and half refused, never forgotten or revoked; every registration succeeds. CONTROL: cycle 7, the eighth registration, gets ENOSPC on 8a2d5dc (firmware 73047f7c, which retires only revoked seals) and on the firmware before A10 (image 92a5cb35)
modes.hold: PASS (A10, across applications): five applications at once, each with a live context and six dead registrations it never forgets, 40 slot claims against 32 slots, all held together (guest monotonic 120726 to 140580 ms); every one passes and its live context still returns 42, so another application's dead registrations were retired, by an adoption or by a launch (which of the two is not recorded). CONTROL on the firmware and module before A10 (image 92a5cb35): holders 1 and 3 get ENOSPC at dead registration 5, their seventh adoption
modes.foreign: PASS (A13, foreign owner): a victim application registers context 0x2100000001 and waits; a second application sends STEP and FORGET for it and for the victim's first context 0x1c00000000: STEP -1 (EPERM) and FORGET -116 (ESTALE) each time; the victim then steps its context to EXITED and forgets it with 0, so no foreign request acted

regression.host_tools: runtime/host unittest 22/22, the new QMP backlog test included

method: capstone-vm, one boot for the probe (29 modes), the signal contract and the application gate; ctl-wfi from a second boot of the same files; A7 and its control, and A9 on its test firmware, in boots of their own; the A10 controls from boots with the earlier firmware and module and image 92a5cb35 (the same source for those modes); the BEFORE readings of A12 from a boot with the previous supervisor (image f6efd377). perl.dom and mruby.dom are the delegation-signals images, so the gate's real-application checks do not exercise this branch's runtime, but every launch, share, step and destroy in the gate runs on the new monitor, driver and supervisor
notes: first boot on this platform halted in the monitor: capstone-c had generated cincoffset t0, t0, t0 in create_domain (an array capability used as its own offset after a spilled index was lost); the build now refuses that pattern (check-cincoffset, positive-controlled on that output) and the slot bookkeeping moved into small functions
a minted context has no transport of its own yet: its launcher thread ends at the first return without EXITED; per-context transport is Probe B's runtime integration

the first run of duplicate-adopt and rollback-thread failed and found a monitor defect: ldc copies and does not clear its source, so the descriptor kept a second copy of an adopted seal and the next call offered it again under ticket 0; loan_end now clears the slot after loading it, and both modes pass

A12 found that a supervised context could leave C-mode: mret was carried out (PRV_C == PRV_M) and a seal's privilege field was honoured; the supervisor now refuses both (qemu/context-slots), and the monitor, driver and launcher carry the REFUSED step event

A10: the monitor retires a minted registration whose seal no longer reads as sealed (a revoked seal reloads untagged) or whose context has ended with a valid seal (a STEP faulted or was refused), when an adoption finds no descriptor for its application, or no slot, and when a new application block finds no slot; a slot with an outstanding offer is kept. A new block takes a free slot instead of the next index, so contexts cannot use up the launch budget; unmanaged domains get their own slot kind so a context never takes their slot. The driver drops the records of a slot the monitor has just reissued, and sizes its table by the monitor's slot count (process-abi.h CAPSTONE_PROCESS_SLOTS; the monitor refuses to build when its table differs, positive-controlled with 31)

A2 found that capstone-qemu enforces no capability permission on a data access (op_helper.c _helper_access_with_cap checks tag, revocation, UNINIT loads and bounds), so the loan's write-only restriction holds only in the loan's metadata on this platform (ISSUES Q-14)

an adversarial review of 8a2d5dc found that an adoption could retire its own dead offering slot and register a null seal, and that ended contexts were never retired; 658063f fixes both. The first is not reachable through today's launcher, which adopts only from an application's first context, and rests on the review

the first full run on 658063f failed hold on the host side: five concurrent capstone-vm runs each connect to QEMU's QMP socket, whose listener has a backlog of one, and a timed connect to a full backlog fails at once with EAGAIN; capstone_vm now retries within its timeout (unit test fails without the retry), and the run was repeated

A2 retracted 2026-09-30: an independent review loaded the caller's saved state through the return capability ra, monitor capabilities included, on the platform of this record. capstone-qemu does not enforce the spec's access rule for synchronous sealed-return capabilities; entry-audit never looked at what ra reaches

A2 reinstated 2026-09-30 after the P0 fix: capstone-qemu a53ac18e3d enforces the spec's sealed-return access window, and the ra-slot0/16/32 modes (fault) with ra-gp (no fault) are its controls, the pre-fix binary 9b6eac4b being the positive control

P1 (review 2026-09-30): a THREAD-mode context's Linux thread blocked signals only after it started; the launcher's signal trampoline has one producer, so a caught signal in that window could race the ring. The launcher now blocks every signal around pthread_create so the child starts blocked (exec.c). Code-level fix; the deterministic adversarial probe is Probe B's B8 (signals during a stepping context), domain phase. Validated by the full regression on the new launcher

generations.case: A9, in boots of their own with a test firmware whose slots start at generation 0x7ffffff9 (the monitor built with -DCAPSTONE_TEST_GEN_PRESET=0x7ffffff9, applied at the first assignment); run-context.py --only gen-exhaust gen-launch
generations.gen-exhaust: PASS: 13 context ids from 0x7ffffffa00000001; slots 1 and 2 ran through 0x7ffffffa..0x7fffffff and were not used again; every id new and positive; replacement 0x7ffffffb00000003 after 0x7ffffffa00000003, late FORGET ESTALE and STEP refused with the old id, the replacement returned its own value
generations.gen-launch: PASS: eight launches of one application, ids 0x7ffffffb00000000 .. 0x7fffffff00000000 on slot 0, then 0x7ffffffc00000003, 0x7ffffffd00000003, 0x7ffffffe00000003: the cached block left the exhausted slot and stayed on slot 3
generations.control: the same preset on 658063f's rules (limit 0xffffffff, no move; firmware 4eded5db): gen-exhaust cycle 6 gets EIO (generation 0x80000000 makes the id negative), and the sixth launch fails with ENOSPC ('cannot create domain'), after which that application cannot launch again in the boot
generations.first_attempt: the preset was first applied at the monitor's first dpi_call, which this platform never takes: gen-exhaust then ran 64 ids from generation 1 with no slot at the last generation, gen-launch ids 0x200000000..0x900000000, and both failed their 'condition created' checks instead of passing

capability_aba.case: A7, in a boot of its own with CAPSTONE_TEST_NODE_QUERY=1 (run-context.py --only aba), same files as above
capability_aba.aba: PASS: context A's seal on node 79 at 0xc02bd000; A preempted once, its area revoked, STEP DEAD; after 130379 burnt allocations (handle made, revoked, carried on) the next allocation is node 79, which only a collection can have released; the remint's handle, the restored area and the new seal all on node 79 at 0xc02bd000; the new context's first STEP RETURNED with EXITED and its own value 1005
capability_aba.control: with CAPSTONE_TEST_KEEP_DEAD_SLOTS=1 as well (the collector skips drop_dead), the same sequence to the same node and base, and the new context's first STEP faults with cause 24 in lcg_rounds (pc 0xc0229f50), code only A runs, on A's stack capability that the collector had untagged: the old continuation was resumed
capability_aba.first_attempt: the first run faulted with cause 26 at the MREV of the burn loop: a revoke can leave the handle uninitialised; the burn now reinitialises a 16-byte scratch granule
